brand_identity.tagline: An Upcoming Digambar Jain Temple Serving Raleigh and the Research Triangle
brand_identity.brand_personality: Sophisticated, spiritual, serene, traditional, elegant, welcoming, timeless, sacred, community-focused
brand_identity.art_direction: Award-worthy Awwwards Site-of-the-Day editorial sacred minimalism. Kinetic hero with line-by-line reveal, numbered manifesto chapters, slow editorial marquee, custom 3D lotus/shikhar ambient moment, authentic Digambar Jain symbols (Ahimsa wheel, Shikhar spires, Jali latticework, Lotus motifs), high-contrast warm ivory and deep maroon palettes, and smooth lenis momentum scrolling.
brand_identity.strict_rule: Must remain strictly authentic to Digambar Jain identity — NO generic Hindu/Buddhist/Sikh imagery, deities, or symbols.

usage_guidelines.backgrounds: Use Warm Ivory (#FFF9ED) as main page canvas. Light Warm Ivory (#FFFDF7) for cards with subtle 1px border. Deep Maroon (#6F1D1B) reserved for high-impact contrast sections like Vision Pillars & Contact Hero.
usage_guidelines.text: Charcoal (#292929) for body readability. Deep Maroon (#6F1D1B) for major headlines. Muted Gold (#C99A30) for labels, numbers, and sacred mantras.
usage_guidelines.ctas: Primary CTA in Deep Maroon button with Muted Gold hover stroke, or Saffron (#E87524) accent. Secondary CTA in outlined Maroon with Warm Ivory background.

font_families.mantra_devanagari: 'Rozha One', 'Tiro Devanagari Marathi', 'Noto Serif Devanagari', serif

numbered_manifesto_chapters.subtitle: Be Part of Building Our Legacy

sections_breakdown.01_header: Glassmorphism header: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FFF9ED]/80 border-b border-[#6F1D1B]/10. DJCR Shikhar Logo on left, nav items, 'Support Vision' CTA button. Mobile sheet drawer.
sections_breakdown.02_hero: Hero section with 3D/Canvas background, line-by-line motion reveal of title, 'णमो अरिहंताणं', supporting devotional text, and dual CTAs.
sections_breakdown.03_welcome: Jai Jinendra welcome section with authentic Digambar Jain greeting, introduction to the RTP sangh, and architectural photo with Arch cutout border.
sections_breakdown.04_temple_vision: Four Pillars: 1. Jin Mandir (Sacred Temple), 2. Swadhyay (Self-Study & Scriptures), 3. Pathshala (Children & Youth Education), 4. Community (Sangh Unity & Harmony). Interactive expandable cards.
sections_breakdown.05_jain_dharma: Three Tirthankar Principles: Ahimsa (Non-violence in thought, word, deed), Anekantavada (Multi-faceted truth & tolerance), Aparigraha (Non-attachment). Sacred Devanagari typography.
sections_breakdown.06_temple_project: Milestone Roadmap ('Our Journey Has Begun'): Vision -> Planning -> Property Selection -> Architectural Design -> Fundraising -> Construction -> Pratishtha Mahotsav. Interactive timeline slider/nodes.
sections_breakdown.07_events: Filterable/Tabbed events (All, Parv, Pathshala, Swadhyay): Dash Lakshan Parv, Mahavir Jayanti, Kshamavani, Weekly Swadhyay, Vidhan Puja, Kids Pathshala, Community Gatherings. Modal registration dialog with Sonner toast feedback.
sections_breakdown.08_get_involved: Action Cards: 1. Join Community, 2. Volunteer Seva, 3. Support Temple Vision, 4. Receive Event Updates, 5. Join WhatsApp Sangh Group.
sections_breakdown.09_contact: Connect with DJCR contact form (Name, Email, Phone, Subject, Message, Submit button) + Sangh contact details (Email, Phone, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube links).
sections_breakdown.10_footer: Deep Maroon dark surface with gold 'Jai Jinendra 🙏', quick nav links, newsletter signup, copyright notice, and subtle lotus footer watermark.

motion_and_interactivity.smooth_scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll initialized on mount
motion_and_interactivity.scroll_reveal: framer-motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion_and_interactivity.hover_effects: Subtle y-axis translation (-4px), border gold glow, and button inner shimmer transition

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive buttons, form elements, tab filters, dialog triggers, and links MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="hero-vision-cta", data-testid="contact-submit-btn").
testing_and_accessibility.file_extension: All source components are JavaScript React (.js / .jsx). Do NOT generate TypeScript (.tsx) files.
testing_and_accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure all text on warm ivory or deep maroon meets APCA / WCAG AA accessibility standards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page responsive React landing page in /app/frontend/src/App.js (or modular components under /app/frontend/src/components/).
Install and integrate lenis for smooth momentum scrolling and framer-motion for line-by-line kinetic hero reveals.
Include a dynamic 3D or ambient interactive canvas background in the hero (using Three.js / R3F or HTML5 Canvas golden particle lotus).
Strictly enforce the color palette: Warm Ivory #FFF9ED canvas, Deep Maroon #6F1D1B, Saffron #E87524, Muted Gold #C99A30, Charcoal #292929 text.
Ensure all events have interactive registration modals with Sonner toast feedback upon submission.
Ensure the contact form handles client-side state and shows a polished success confirmation toast.
Include 'data-testid' on every button, nav item, card, filter, input, and link.
